title: Pricing request orchestration and escalation grid for enterprise exceptions
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Purpose: Define a lightweight orchestration + escalation grid to consistently triage enterprise pricing and billing requests that are non-bug (commitments, invoice adjustments, cost allocation, marketplace credits). Goal is to reduce cycle time, ensure correct routing to Finance/Sales/Legal/Engineering, and make approval boundaries explicit for SDRs/CS/AMs.

Background: We get a mix of requests ranging from simple invoice corrections to multi-year commitment negotiations and marketplace credit exceptions. Current handling is ad-hoc, leading to inconsistent outcomes and slow responses for high-impact customers. This ticket standardizes intake, triage criteria, routing rules, SLAs, and the documentation required for approvals so Sales and Finance can act quickly and reproducibly.

Scope: Enterprise (contracted) customers only. Covers: commitment-level discounts/exceptions, invoice disputes/credits, marketplace seller credit offsets, reallocation of committed spend across orgs, and adjustments tied to contract terms. Excludes billing system (invoicing engine) bug fixes and tax-related requests (send to Tax).
acceptance_criteria:
1) A documented intake form and minimum required fields (customer ARR, contract id, requested outcome, scope, GL impact) published to the CS/Sales wiki.
2) A triage matrix that maps request attributes (customer_impact, ARR tier, contract type, time-sensitivity, technical dependency) to a routing decision (Finance ops, Sales PM, Legal review, Eng support).
3) Escalation grid with approval thresholds and SLAs: auto-approve (<$5k one-off), Finance approval required ($5k-$50k), Executive approval needed (>$50k or >1yr term/mo).
4) Test run with 3 historical examples validated by Finance/Sales with documented outcomes.
5) Dashboard tile showing time-to-resolution and number of escalations for first 30 days after rollout.
workflow:
Intake -> Triage by CS/AM (via new form) -> Route to owner (Finance Ops / Sales PM / Legal / Eng) -> Owner either approves or escalates per grid -> Finance posts credit/adjustment and confirms closure.

Intake form minimum fields: Customer name, Customer ARR tier, Contract ID, Request type (commitment/credit/invoice/allocation), Requested amount or qualitative outcome, Business justification, Urgency (P0-P3), Attachments (contract excerpt / invoice), Customer-facing consequences if delayed.

Triage rules (high level):
- If urgency == P0 or customer_impact == high AND ARR >= $1M => fast-track to Finance ops + Sales PM, 24h SLA initial ack.
- If request requires engineering change (billing logic / metering) -> create ENG ticket and assign priority matching customer impact; Engineering response expected within 48h.
- Marketplace credit requests require seller verification doc + marketplace ops approval; small credits auto-route to Marketplace Ops.

SLA targets: Initial acknowledgement in 24h for high-impact, 72h for medium, 5 business days for low. Full resolution SLA depends on approval tier (auto: 3 business days, Finance review: 7-10 business days, Executive review: 14 business days).
